class.name: ECSSystem

method.name: _get_component_filter
method.description: Override to restrict entity events to entities that have all of the returned components (names or ids); global events are unaffected. Default: no filter.

method.name: _get_events
method.description: Override to return the events this system wants (ids from [enum ECSWorld.Event] or names, including custom events registered with [method ECSWorld.register_event]). Called once when the system is registered; at least one event is required.

method.name: _on_registered
method.description: Called after the system was added to a world ([method get_world] is valid).

method.name: _on_unregistered
method.description: Called after the system was removed from its world.

method.name: _process_event
method.description: Receives every subscribed event. [param event] has the same keys as the dictionaries passed to [method ECSWorld.subscribe] callables: [code skip-lint]event[/code], [code]name[/code], [code]entity[/code], [code]component[/code], [code]delta[/code], [code]peer[/code], [code]net_id[/code], [code]payload[/code].

method.name: get_world
method.description: Returns the world the system is registered in, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: is_registered
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the system is registered in a world.

members.member: Disabled systems keep their subscription but receive no events.
Dispatch order relative to other subscriptions of the same event (lower first). Set it before registering the system.
